 Hon'Ble Harvir Singh, J.
1.  Heard learned counsel for the revisionists, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant revision has been filed against the order dated 17.5.2023 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Baghpat in Criminal Case No. 1342 of 2011 (State vs. Aavesh Sharma and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 1186 of 2013, under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 336, 504 I.P.C.
and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Baraut, District-Baghpat, by which the revisionists have been summoned on the application moved under Section 319 Cr.P.C. by the opposite party no. 2.
3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionists has submitted that both the revisionists are the sisters-in-law (jethani) of opposite party no. 2. and only vague, sweeping and bald allegations have been made against them.

He next submitted that the revisionists have been falsely implicated in the said Case Crime and the order passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate in respect of Case Crime No.
1186 of 2013, under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 336, 504 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act is wholly illegal, arbitrary and the same is liable to be set aside.

He further submitted that only single witness has been examined and on the basis of her testimony, the prospective accused, i.e.
revisionists herein have been summoned.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has submitted that the order passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate is in accordance with law, as the allegations of assault upon opposite party no. 2 have been levelled against the revisionists and other persons and consequent to that assault, the opposite party no. 2 sustained injuries.
He further submitted that the injuries sustained by the injured are simple in nature and the opposite party no. 2 is ready to join her matrimonial house, if the circumstances so warrants.

5. Having heard the rival contentions and perusal of the order dated 17.05.2023, it can be seen that the said order for summoning the prospective accused, i.e. the revisionist herein is based on the single testimony of PW-1.
Since the vague, sweeping and bald allegations have been made against the revisionists, these allegations are not sufficient to implicate the revisionists in the present case crime.
No other cogent material has been placed on record, on the basis of which the involvement of the revisionists is fully established.
6. Under the circumstances, the revision is allowed.
The order dated 17.5.2023 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Baghpat is hereby set aside.

(Harvir Singh,J.) October 7, 2025 Faridul  Rakhi And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69725599/
